reference.title: EDE state texts support file
reference.shortdesc: This file provides a reference number and lists enumeration state texts for multi-state and binary objects.

section.p: The CSV file includes “State-Texts” in its name.
You cannot mix multi-state and binary texts under the same reference number, that is, in the same row.
Each row consists of Inactive-Text, Active-Text or Text 1 and so on. An empty column indicates unused or not-supported states.
